wgtgm-mini-player.welcomePageHTML:
Welcome to Mini Player

Be part of the Mini Player Community

Join us on Discord.

Supporting the development

If you want to support the development, consider taking a look at the membership options on Patreon.

Documentation

Feeling a little lost? Head over to our documentation page for some direction, or jump on Discord and ask a question.

ui.tagGroupToggleTitle: Click open or close, Shift-click include all, Shift-right-click exclude all
ui.rescanComplete: Mini Player: Music library rescan complete.

sceneConfig.playPlaylistHint: Optional playlist to open in Mini Player when this scene becomes active. If no track is selected, Mini Player starts a random track. Ignored if Mini Player Tags are set.
sceneConfig.playPlaylistSoundHint: Optional track to play when this scene becomes active. Leave blank to start a random track from the selected playlist.
sceneConfig.playTagsHint: Comma-separated tags to open in tag mode and autoplay when this scene becomes active. Prefix a tag with "-" or use "not(tag)" to exclude it. Include "ttrpg" to enable the TTRPG source toggle.
sceneConfig.playPresetHint: Optional preset to play when this scene becomes active. If tags are also set, the preset loads first and Mini Player tag playback can then take over the music layer.
sceneConfig.stopMiniPlayerOnStartHint: When this scene becomes active, stop currently playing music before applying scene playlist, scene track, preset, or tags.
sceneConfig.stopAllSoundsOnStartHint: When this scene becomes active, stop all currently playing sounds before applying scene playlist, scene track, preset, or tags.

combatTracker.autoplayHint: If enabled, the Mini Player combat audio settings below will be applied when combat starts.
combatTracker.stopMiniPlayerOnStartHint: Stop currently playing music before applying the selected Mini Player playlist or tags. This is always enabled while Autoplay is on.
combatTracker.stopAllSoundsOnStartHint: Stop all currently playing playlists and tracks before applying combat Mini Player and Soundboard selections.
combatTracker.miniPlaylistHint: Optional playlist to open in Mini Player when combat starts. If set, it takes priority over Mini Player Tags.
combatTracker.miniTagsHint: Comma-separated tags to open in Mini Player tag mode when combat starts. Prefix a tag with "-" or use "not(tag)" to exclude it. Include "ttrpg" to enable the TTRPG source toggle. Ignored if a Mini Player Playlist is selected.
combatTracker.soundboardTagsHint: Comma-separated tags to open in Soundboard tag mode when combat starts. Prefix a tag with "-" or use "not(tag)" to exclude it.
combatTracker.presetHint: Optional preset to play when combat starts. The preset loads first, then Mini Player playlist/tag playback can take over the music layer, and the previous audio state is restored when combat ends.

runonlyonce.name: Welcome message disabled
runonlyonce.hint: Disable to see the Welcome Message

rememberOpenState.name: Remember the player and soundboard state.
rememberOpenState.hint: Opens the Player and Soundboard on load if they were open when Foundry was closed.

enableCrossfade.name: Enable crossfade
enableCrossfade.hint: If enabled crossfade will be applied to music playlists

enableSoundboardCrossfade.name: Enable crossfade on Soundboard
enableSoundboardCrossfade.hint: If enabled crossfade will be applied to soundboard playlists

crossfadeDuration.name: Crossfade duration (seconds)
crossfadeDuration.hint: Set the length of crossfade between tracks in seconds

maxTrackCount.name: Maximum number of tracks in a Tag Playlist
maxTrackCount.hint: Limits the number of tracks in the tag playlist created dynamically in the Mini Player

musicFolder.name: Base music folder
musicFolder.hint: Folder where playlists are created from, folders with -sfx will be added as Soundboard Only

includePlaylistSoundsInTagScan.name: Include non-Mini Player playlists in tag scans
includePlaylistSoundsInTagScan.hint: Also scan sounds from playlists that were not created by Mini Player. Duplicate tracks are ignored using each sound path.

setToLoop.name: Set Soundboard Playlist tracks to loop
setToLoop.hint: Imported tracks in Soundboard Only playlists will be set to loop

setToEnvironment.name: Set Soundboard Playlist channel to Environment
setToEnvironment.hint: Imported Soundboard Only playlists will be set to the Environment channel

setMusicToLoop.name: Set Music Playlist tracks to loop
setMusicToLoop.hint: Imported tracks in Music playlists will be set to loop

playOnSelect.name: Play on Track Select
playOnSelect.hint: Automatically play a track when it is selected from the dropdown list.

combatPlayTags.name: Combat Play Tags
combatPlayTags.hint: Comma-separated tags to open in Mini Player tag mode and autoplay when combat starts. Include "ttrpg" to enable the TTRPG source toggle.

combatPlayPlaylist.name: Combat Play Playlist
combatPlayPlaylist.hint: Playlist to open in Mini Player when combat starts. If set, it takes priority over Combat Play Tags.

combatPlayPreset.name: Combat Play Preset
combatPlayPreset.hint: Preset to play when combat starts. The preset loads first, then Mini Player playlist/tag playback can take over the music layer, and the previous audio state is restored when combat ends.

combatSoundboardTags.name: Combat Soundboard Tags
combatSoundboardTags.hint: Comma-separated tags to open in Soundboard tag mode when combat starts.

combatAutoplayOnStart.name: Autoplay on Combat Start
combatAutoplayOnStart.hint: If enabled, combat audio automation will run when combat starts.

combatStopMiniPlayerOnStart.name: Stop Mini Player Music First
combatStopMiniPlayerOnStart.hint: Stop currently playing music before applying combat Mini Player playlist/tag selections. This is always enabled while Autoplay is on.

combatStopAllSoundsOnStart.name: Stop All Sounds First
combatStopAllSoundsOnStart.hint: Stop all currently playing playlists and tracks before applying combat Mini Player and Soundboard selections.

stopOnNewSoundboard.name: Stop on new Sound
stopOnNewSoundboard.hint: Stop playback of the soundboard track when a new Soundboard sound is played.

playTrackWhenDroppedOnMixer.name: Play track when dropped on mixer
playTrackWhenDroppedOnMixer.hint: If disabled, dropping a playlist track on the mixer adds it as a queued mixer row without auto-playing.

stopOnNewPlaylist.name: Stop on New Playlist
stopOnNewPlaylist.hint: Stop playback of the current track when a track from a new playlist is selected.

linkTTRPG.name: Link with TTRPG Music (Patreon)
linkTTRPG.hint: Enable integration with the Tabletop RPG Music module. Requires the module to be installed and active.

dockSidebar.name: Dock to Playlists
dockSidebar.hint: If enabled, the player will be docked to the playlist panel.
